policy.rule: Surface-identical candidate forms must be resolved by candidate-specific family bindings before publication coverage is granted.
policy.surfaceMatchFallback: Allowed only when no collision binding exists for that candidate/form.

collisions.reason: CID is a genuine homograph across two Latin families: compounds of caedo 'cut/kill' and compounds of cado 'fall'. Coverage must preserve candidate family identity instead of accepting every published CID surface match.
